items.q: famous names of bands from the Savoy Ballroom -- Claude Hopkins, Chick Webb... all the bands that ever played there, all them guys hang around there.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

sleep late and they and they come around around 3, 4, 5 o'clock in the afternoon and they all congregate in the River Club, famous names of bands from the Savoy Ballroom -- Claude Hopkins, Chick Webb, Savoy Sultans, Lucky Millinder, Cecil Scott had a group there at the Savoy, all the bands that ever played there, all them guys hang around there. Some faces looked familiar and then some faces are famous. I met one or two guys that I used to remember on the road. I met Claude Hopkins in Dallas, while I was in…
Did you join the union right away?
